record_scope: Historical October 2 snapshot; the October 9 review_update below supersedes its model-retention and independent-holdout interpretation, not its archived observations.
historical_test_protocol: Archived internal held-out lesions, eight-view legacy TTA, validation-selected blend, temperature, and threshold. Not a new independent confirmation.
reused_development_protocol: One-view, fixed 0.5 output blend, five group-cross-fitted thresholds. Different protocol from release inference.

reused_development_baseline.limitation: Development cross-fitting separates threshold calibration from scoring groups, not model development from validation. Repeatedly inspected validation is not an independent test. The requested calibration sensitivity is not guaranteed on scoring folds.

review_update.protocol: Matched canonical lesion scores on 4177 reused validation lesions, with group-separated threshold calibration and scoring; 290 melanoma lesions. The current runs avoid the known contaminated local warm-start lineage.
review_update.feature_head_followup: None improved on the current development reference while meeting the overall 95 percent sensitivity target.
limitations: Validation informed checkpoint selection and repeated experiments; group-separated calibration does not make it an independent confirmation cohort.
DERM12345 sensitivity fell from 96.83 percent to 92.06 percent; an overall 95 percent result does not establish a source-specific floor.
The comparison does not isolate the causal effect of sampling changes.
